title: CapabilityProfile
description: What one device can do, measured once per page load by the runtime. Used by manifests (minimum requirements), by the backend fallback chain and later by control-plane policy. Wire format: airplanemode.capability/0.1. Never contains navigator.userAgent, userAgentData, adapter description or device strings.

gpu.description: webgpu iff navigator.gpu.requestAdapter() returned an adapter.

ramGb.description: navigator.deviceMemory in GiB (browsers cap it at 8). 0 = unknown.

storageFreeGb.description: (quota - usage) / 2^30 rounded to 2 decimals from navigator.storage.estimate(). 0 if unknown.

backendTier.description: webgpu-f16 if the adapter has shader-f16; webgpu-f32 if an adapter exists; wasm-simd if WebAssembly.validate accepts the SIMD probe; wasm if WebAssembly exists; else none.

measuredAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of the measurement.

details.description: Flat, allow-listed adapter details only: vendor and architecture (from adapter.info) and the numeric limits maxBufferSize, maxStorageBufferBindingSize, maxComputeWorkgroupStorageSize, maxComputeInvocationsPerWorkgroup. Adapter description and device strings are dropped (driver-version fingerprint). No personal data.
